surfaces.name: "/proc/self/environ"
surfaces.notes: Original C000531 is a real fixed filesystem input. Linux-only, completely empty process.env fallback; native Rust does not need to reproduce the JS environment workaround.

surfaces.name: HOME
surfaces.notes: Original C000532. Home skill discovery chooses process.env.HOME or homedir; unrelated native footer HOME use is not package-resolver parity.

surfaces.name: install
surfaces.notes: Resource source install; native same spelling installs Cargo/prebuilt artifacts.

surfaces.name: remove
surfaces.notes: Remove configured resource source; no equivalent early native remove route.

surfaces.name: uninstall
surfaces.notes: Alias for TS remove; native uninstall removes owned native libraries and has different not-installed status.

surfaces.name: list
surfaces.notes: Raw configured packages grouped user/project, optional installed paths; native package list is a different route.

surfaces.name: update
surfaces.notes: Default self target with skipped-extension note; native parser has force/build only.

surfaces.name: config
surfaces.notes: Resolve global/project resources, trust gate, then CLI-016 selector wrapper.

surfaces.name: --ice-mode
surfaces.notes: Only leading well-formed mode arguments are stripped before this subcommand parser; generic flag ownership remains main CLI.

surfaces.name: --ice-mode=<value>
surfaces.notes: Inline leading mode spelling is stripped by the package/config adapter.

surfaces.name: --local
surfaces.notes: Package install/remove scope; config accepts its own local write scope. Invalid on update/list.

surfaces.name: -l
surfaces.notes: Short local scope flag, same command restrictions.

surfaces.name: --approve
surfaces.notes: Boolean true override; repeated approval/no-approval flags use last occurrence.

surfaces.name: -a
surfaces.notes: Short explicit approval flag.

surfaces.name: --no-approve
surfaces.notes: Boolean false override; update still uses saved-only trust absent override.

surfaces.name: -na
surfaces.notes: Short explicit no-approval flag.

surfaces.name: --help
surfaces.notes: Help anywhere wins over invalid options, missing values and target conflicts.

surfaces.name: -h
surfaces.notes: Short help flag with TS help-first behavior.

surfaces.name: --force
surfaces.notes: Update-only; TS still fetches checked release and installs exact target even if current.

surfaces.name: --self
surfaces.notes: Explicit CLI self-update target; can combine with --extensions only for all.

surfaces.name: --extensions
surfaces.notes: All configured package updates; combines with --self; conflicts with individual/models/all forms.

surfaces.name: --extension <source>
surfaces.notes: Requires one non-flag source; individual extension update target.

surfaces.name: --all
surfaces.notes: Self plus extensions; exclusive with other explicit target forms.

surfaces.name: --models
surfaces.notes: Early model-catalog refresh; local create network disabled then forced refresh network enabled; 15-second abort timer.

surfaces.name: update self
surfaces.notes: Positional alias selecting self.

surfaces.name: update ice
surfaces.notes: Positional alias selecting self.

surfaces.name: update <source>
surfaces.notes: Identity-select all raw scope matches; missing npm prefix may produce configured-source suggestion.

surfaces.name: packages
surfaces.notes: Scoped array of source strings or filter objects; preserve filter object on identity replacement.

surfaces.name: packages[].source
surfaces.notes: Required source string for object form; source identity ignores npm version/Git ref.

surfaces.name: packages[].autoload
surfaces.notes: false selects sequential matched-only overrides, used for inherited project deltas.

surfaces.name: packages[].extensions
surfaces.notes: Resource filter string array; omitted differs from empty; +,-,! and glob semantics.

surfaces.name: packages[].skills
surfaces.notes: Includes SKILL.md parent-path aliases in matching.

surfaces.name: packages[].prompts
surfaces.notes: Package prompt filters operate after manifest candidate selection.

surfaces.name: packages[].themes
surfaces.notes: Package theme filters cannot re-enable manifest-excluded files.

surfaces.name: extensions
surfaces.notes: Top-level explicit resource paths/overrides; global own key suppresses project key under globalFirst.

surfaces.name: skills
surfaces.notes: Top-level skill paths plus automatic .ice/.agents roots; trust and scope ranks apply.

surfaces.name: prompts
surfaces.notes: Top-level prompt paths/overrides; automatic prompts scan direct files.

surfaces.name: themes
surfaces.notes: Top-level theme paths/overrides; automatic themes scan direct JSON files.

surfaces.name: npmCommand
surfaces.notes: Stored executable/argument array shared with SET-002; package-manager-specific flags here. Self-update uses only global setting.

surfaces.name: ICE_OFFLINE
surfaces.notes: Package truth values: exact 1 or lowercased true/yes, no trim; skips remote update checks/updates and missing acquisition.

surfaces.name: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT
surfaces.notes: Remote Git metadata checks set 0; clone/fetch do not uniformly inject it.

surfaces.name: <agentDir>/tmp/extensions
surfaces.notes: Created recursively and chmod 0700; cache persists beyond the run.

surfaces.name: <agentDir>/npm/node_modules
surfaces.notes: Managed user resource package cache, separate from native artifacts.

surfaces.name: <projectConfigDir>/npm/node_modules
surfaces.notes: Managed project npm cache guarded by trust.

surfaces.name: <scopeRoot>/git/<host>/<repository-path>
surfaces.notes: Strict lexical descendant target after parsed Git host/path validation.

surfaces.name: <agentDir>/tmp/extensions/npm/<hash8>/node_modules
surfaces.notes: Temporary source cache identity, not npm version per-run storage.

surfaces.name: <agentDir>/tmp/extensions/git-<host>/<hash8>/<repository-path>
surfaces.notes: Temporary Git source cache; unpinned online refresh is best-effort.

surfaces.name: .<repository>.ice-update-incomplete
surfaces.notes: Sibling marker written before reset/clean and retained on failure; retry completion, not rollback.

surfaces.name: <managed-npm-root>/package.json
surfaces.notes: Create only if absent: name ice-extensions and private true.

surfaces.name: <managed-root>/.gitignore
surfaces.notes: Create only if absent with '*' then '!.gitignore'.

surfaces.name: .gitignore
surfaces.notes: Read ignore rules only from scan root downward, prefix nested rules.

surfaces.name: .ignore
surfaces.notes: Additional nested ignore file with same matching normalization.

surfaces.name: .fdignore
surfaces.notes: Additional nested ignore file with same matching normalization.

surfaces.name: SKILL.md
surfaces.notes: Skill file stops recursion in its directory; ignored/nonexistent file does not.

surfaces.name: package.json:ice
surfaces.notes: Own ice field wins wholesale; malformed ice does not downgrade to pi (EXT-005).

surfaces.name: package.json:pi
surfaces.notes: Legacy fallback only when own ice field absent; no merging.

surfaces.name: package.json:ice.extensions
surfaces.notes: Manifest resource array/globs/overrides; existing entrypoints suppress index fallback.

surfaces.name: package.json:ice.skills
surfaces.notes: Skill candidates and manifest filters precede user filters.

surfaces.name: package.json:ice.prompts
surfaces.notes: Declared package prompt directories can recurse; omitted field/empty array differ by filter branch.

surfaces.name: package.json:ice.themes
surfaces.notes: Declared package theme resources; explicit files can bypass convention suffix check.

surfaces.name: extensions/index.ts
surfaces.notes: Directory entrypoint preferred before index.js after missing/empty effective manifest entries.

surfaces.name: extensions/index.js
surfaces.notes: Fallback entrypoint after index.ts.

surfaces.name: extensions/
surfaces.notes: Automatic direct TS/JS files plus one-level manifest/index subdirectories.

surfaces.name: skills/
surfaces.notes: ICE-style skill discovery allows root markdown and SKILL.md subtree stopping.

surfaces.name: prompts/
surfaces.notes: Automatic direct .md files; package-declared directories use recursive collector.

surfaces.name: themes/
surfaces.notes: Automatic direct .json files; package-declared directories use recursive collector.

surfaces.name: <ancestor>/.agents/skills
surfaces.notes: cwd to nearest .git boundary inclusive, or filesystem root when absent; nested SKILL.md mode.

surfaces.name: <HOME>/.agents/skills
surfaces.notes: Classified as user scope and excluded from the project-ancestor list.

surfaces.name: .git
surfaces.notes: Existence marks ancestor skill-discovery boundary; no Git subprocess used for boundary discovery.

surfaces.name: PackageManager progress.start
surfaces.notes: Called before try; callback throw is not converted to wrapper error.

surfaces.name: PackageManager progress.complete
surfaces.notes: Called inside try after operation; callback failure emits error.

surfaces.name: PackageManager progress.error
surfaces.notes: Carries string error message, source and action before rethrow.

surfaces.name: ProgressEvent type=progress
surfaces.notes: Declared event type; wrapper itself emits start/complete/error, not guaranteed periodic progress.

surfaces.name: MissingSourceAction
surfaces.notes: Callback outcome install|skip|error; default install; offline missing path bypasses callback.

surfaces.name: ProgressEvent action
surfaces.notes: Declared install|remove|update|clone|pull operation enum; one mutable callback.

claims.claim: Versioned npm specs are all pinned and skipped by updates.
claims.correction: Only valid exact semver is pinned. Valid ranges and dist-tags are not all skipped; the source's exact/range/tag rules govern.

claims.claim: Temporary extension package installation is for the current run only.
claims.correction: Configuration is temporary, but agentDir/tmp/extensions caches persist; temporary unpinned Git is refreshed best-effort and no per-run deletion is implemented.

rust_only.title: Native Cargo artifact installation, ownership locking and rollback to preserve
rust_only.preservation: Retain the Cargo backend, strict mutation registry, artifact ownership checks, lock, staging and rollback when adding resource-package commands. Do not replace them with TS's weaker payload-then-settings ordering. Keep backend-specific registries separate and expose native versus resource-package identities explicitly in the command facade. No new Rust implementation is required for this retained capability; size is zero and compatibility work is counted in the owning source/CLI entries.

rust_only.title: Verified native extension prebuilt distribution and publisher provenance to preserve
rust_only.preservation: Preserve the bounded manifest/archive protocol, publisher continuity, provenance and object validation while adding TS resource backends. Keep verification before activation and runtime ABI loading after it. No new Rust implementation is estimated for this retained capability. Do not loosen archive/path/hash limits to make TS package naming fit, and do not treat downloaded native libraries as equivalent to JS package directories.

rust_only.title: Native startup update cache, per-entry freshness and backend-aware notices to preserve
rust_only.preservation: Retain native result classification, freshness, merge locking and publisher-aware keys. Add resource-package notices through explicit backend-tagged records and shared presentation only after CLI-028 exists. Preserve the distinction between automatic native disable flags and TS explicit update-service behavior. No replacement implementation is required for this retained capability; size is zero.
